overview: The published mix comprises 30 one-bedroom, 32 two-bedroom and one three-bedroom home: 63 in total. Configuration: G + 2 podiums + 8 residential floors + rooftop.
research.locationNote: Dubai Islands, Dubai; the fourth Sunset Bay release.
research.priceNote: No developer price list was retrieved. Bayut records an AED 1.91m launch reference; Property Finder advertises from AED 2.2m while also marking developer stock sold out. These do not establish current availability.
research.handoverNote: Developer FAQ and original payment sheet forecast June 2027, within Q2. Property Finder gives May 2027. Actual completion remains unverified.
research.paymentNote: Historical May 2025 booking schedule shown; 20% booking, 40% construction and 40% completion total 100%. Confirm current dates and contractual terms.
